rationale: The assistant used the paper test and the customer's seal findings to correctly identify a torn freezer door seal. It recommended a replacement only after damage was confirmed, and asked for the model number. When the customer gave the model, it offered a search term and an honest 'can't confirm a match' caveat rather than inventing a part number. It also advised safe defrosting with no sharp tools. Minor flaws: the first reply was long and listed frost-free causes that don't apply to a static freezer, and a model-number panel was shown after the model was still pending. The late advice to ask for a service code and the cost weighing are reasonable but slightly repetitive on the drawer advice.
